note: Hand-kept list of adult leagues. Check each link once a season.

leagues.name: Mecklenburg County Park & Rec
leagues.what: County-run adult leagues at parks and rec centers around Charlotte, usually the cheapest option. Seasons open for registration a few weeks ahead.

leagues.name: SportsLink
leagues.what: Charlotte's big social sports league: sign up solo or with a team, play one night a week, bar after. Sand volleyball in Charlotte and Belmont.

leagues.name: Goombay Charlotte
leagues.what: Social leagues with co-ed and women's kickball (recent seasons at Revolution Park and Hornets Nest). Check the page for the next season.
